name: Thunderous Trap
body:
School abjuration [sonic]; Level sorcerer/wizard 4

CASTING

Casting Time 10 minutes
Components V, S, M (gold dust worth 25 gp)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target object touched
Duration permanent until discharged (D)
Saving Throw Fortitude half (see text); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

Thunderous trap creates a resounding explosion when an intruder opens the item that the trap protects. A thunderous trap spell can ward any object that can be opened and closed.

When casting thunderous trap, you select a point on the object as the spell’s center. When someone other than you opens the object, the resounding explosion fills the area within a 5-foot radius around the spell’s center.

The sound deals 1d3 points of sonic damage + 1 point per caster level (maximum +20). The item protected by the trap is not harmed by this explosion.

A thunder-trapped item cannot have a second closure or warding spell placed on it. A knock spell does not bypass a thunderous trap. An unsuccessful dispel magic spell does not detonate the spell. This spell does not function in an area of silence.

You can use the thunder-trapped object without discharging it, as can any individual to whom the object was specifically attuned when cast. Attuning a thundertrapped object to an individual usually involves setting a password that you can share with friends.
